name: Demo E: Modeled MEP Redline Route Pickup
description: Run a bounded modeled duct or pipe redline route through /revit/mep-route-workflow and require model write evidence, a passing visual gate, and cleanup evidence for repeated live runs.
setup_instructions: Open the target Revit model and the sheet/view containing the marked MEP route.
Use a prepared deterministic redline route request with ordered model-space points.
Use /revit/mep-route-workflow with apply=true and visualVerify=true; do not report completion from a dry-run.
success_criteria: The workflow returns created duct/pipe element or fitting ids.
Created planned points match the intended route points within tolerance.
A focused post-change capture is returned.
Created duct/pipe route ids are proven in a cleanup dry-run and then deleted after capture and visual-gate evidence is recorded.
failure_criteria: The workflow only dry-runs or returns no created model ids.
The created route points do not match the requested redline route.
The focused visual capture is missing.
The redline visual gate is fail or uncertain.
Cleanup is requested but the created route ids are missing from the cleanup dry-run or applied delete evidence.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers modeled duct/pipe redline pickup only. It is not satisfied by annotation-only pickup or by existing callout text without model evidence.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete the created duct/pipe/fitting ids after visual verification so repeated live reliability runs do not accumulate model clutter.

endpointGrounding.openEndPolicy: Standalone disposable Snowdon route benchmark; created open-ended route is verified visually and deleted in cleanup.
